m1_config.description: M1 v1.2.1 for DEV112P 1dfft parity recordings: (R1) odd/even chirp chains kept separate, each with its own backing; (R2) opening empty-seat calibration for 10 s of valid frames before occupancy judgement is enabled (no 1-frame background lock, no opening false alarm); (R3) F1 background residual normalised by the leakage bin (bin/|bin0|) so the 2.9x site-to-site amplitude spread and the -1.9..-6.2 %/min thermal drift no longer masquerade as occupancy, and the empty-seat decision is driven by the Bin1 micro-motion evidence (detrended frame-to-frame amplitude change, normalised by the opening-empty motion floor). Still-sitting is kept by the 5 s release confirmation; a walk-away releases as soon as the Bin1 micro-motion returns to the empty band for release_frames and the leakage-normalised F1 residual is back within gate, then the empty snapshot is rebuilt from the last 10 s. Config frozen for the C v1.2.1 fix task; v1.2 results (config/M1_dev112p_v0.2.json) are unchanged.

chirp_parity.note: tx_polling=1: odd/even chirps differ ~11x in amplitude (T01 odd ~16200 / even ~1450 counts); averaging them gave the frame-0 +139 counts seed bias.

m1_config.target_count_policy: 1 when presence=1 (single-seat region assumption, documented), 0 when empty, -1 when unknown

notes: generated by tools/live_seat.py for A --live startup (live_monitor.py --live --meta <rid>_meta.json --algorithm <this file>); offline detect.py algorithm.json is the legacy replay format

online v0.1: M1 real-time presence only; posture column is the interface placeholder (not_applicable when empty, unknown when occupied, calibration_status=uncalibrated). Offline M2 v0.1 gated baseline is not online yet (backfill semantics); see CAPABILITIES_AND_KNOWN_ISSUES.md
session diagnostics (region/bg_mode/warnings) in <rid>_session.json written by the same run
